season.evidence: Guide pages: best weather late June into September, snow lingering early; histogram Jun-Sep with an Oct tail; SR 20 open to about Nov.

track.why: Logged route is Spontaneity Arete; track starts and ends about 130 m from the SR-20 turnout pin and tops out 11 m from our summit on 30 Jul 2020.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Unnamed route; starts 536 m east of the pin.

facts.text: Pitch 1 starts from a distinctive dead, U-shaped snag; the hand crack trends left from it.
In mid-June a patch of avalanche debris lies across the path, and the steeper climbers' trail above has three fixed hand-lines.
Several tree rappel anchors have shifted in the loose soil and carry old tat; back them up or replace them.
From the summit anchor drop into the gully on the descent-right side, then walk its loose floor, staying right first and left once it narrows.
Cams from 0.1 to 3 and a full set of nuts (all used in early October)
Tape for the pitch-1 hand crack (August)
